narrative: - He lives in North Carolina. I was stationed with him in the Air Force in 1992. He joined the league in 2017 and hopes to continue to build this team up following the departure of Parkersburg. The 1st season went 8-11 with a lot of injuries. Keith has played FF before but not to the extent that this league is. Welcome to the league, 1st year and already a Jamarcus Russell trophy. Keith finally found the playoffs but is still looking for his 1st playoff win (0-3) but the team is coming along adding a award of OROY (Kyler Murray). He has moved up to 16yh in overall wins.
